system.description:
You must have formed a Blood Contract with a Sage Tribe found in the Summoning Jutsu section in order to successfully cast this jutsu. You do not gain a Blood contract with a sage tribe by learning this jutsu. Follow the rules laid out in that section.

You summon a Sage Beast of a rank equal to the rank you cast this jutsu. If a creature refuses or cannot be summoned, only the technique's base chakra cost is spent.

It appears where the user chooses. You can command it by spending your bonus action, once per turn. You can communicate with the creature and it will only listen to you in combat. You can direct it to perform the following actions:  Attack (Unarmed, Weapon, or Cast a Jutsu Jutsu), Dash, Dodge, Help or Perform a Skill-Action using a skill it is proficient in..

When commanded, the creature can move up to its speed and it gains a Sage Action, which allows it to use any of its actions, abilities, or jutsu, once per command. The summoned creature must remain within 120 feet of the summoner. All sage creatures can speak common.

Once you summon a sage creature, recasting this jutsu only allows you to summon or unsummon the same sage creature at no additional chakra cost. You can summon one unique sage creature using this jutsu per long rest.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, you summon a corresponding creature equal in level and rank to the Rank used upon activation.
